mapper.sql: c.id, c.course_code, c.course_name, c.semester_id, c.dept_id, c.teacher_id, c.credit, c.hours, c.course_type, c.exam_type, c.max_capacity, c.selected_count, c.textbook, c.introduce, c.selectable, c.status, c.version, c.create_time, c.update_time

LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.id = c.teacher_id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = t.user_id AND tu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = c.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN semester s ON s.id = c.semester_id AND s.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT , tu.real_name AS teacherName, d.dept_name AS deptName, s.semester_name AS semesterName FROM course c
WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET selected_count = selected_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{courseId} AND deleted = 0 AND selected_count < max_capacity
UPDATE course SET selected_count = selected_count - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{courseId} AND deleted = 0 AND selected_count > 0

UPDATE course c SET c.selected_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_selection cs WHERE cs.course_id = c.id AND cs.status = 1 AND cs.deleted = 0), c.update_time = NOW() WHERE c.id = #{courseId} AND c.deleted = 0
